api: https://ocw.mit.edu/sitemap.xml (course catalogue) + per-course sitemap.xml + /resources/ pages (transcript PDFs)
name: MIT OpenCourseWare
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): sitemap index answers with 2,587 course sitemaps whose slugs carry the course titles (e.g. 8-282j-introduction-to-astronomy-spring-2006); a matched course's own sitemap lists its /resources/ pages, and a video resource page (5.111 Lecture 1) links its transcript PDF (anchor 'English', 200, %PDF). The site search UI is a JS app (api.learn.mit.edu / api/v0/search returned 404 in every form tried) — the sitemap is the machine catalogue route. Full text = transcript PDFs.

name: Open Yale Courses
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the /courses catalogue lists every course with its department page; ASTR 160's page lists 24 session pages, and session pages carry the FULL lecture transcript in HTML (Lecture 1 page = 43,150 chars of text incl. the timed transcript body). Full text = session-page HTML.

name: NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning, India)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): transcript PDFs exist on archive.nptel.ac.in per the §29 survey, but no machine route was proven from the sandbox. Routes tried: archive.nptel.ac.in/courses/<id>/ (404), /noc/courses/ (404), /nptel/search.html (404), beta.archive.nptel.ac.in (connection closed), nptel.ac.in/courses/<id> (200 but a JS shell whose only PDF link is the template placeholder syllabus_pdf/undefined.pdf; course data loads via an unidentified API). Search/catalogue bar not met.

name: Stanford Engineering Everywhere (SEE)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the /Course catalogue lists the SEE courses (CS106A/B, CS107, CS223A, CS229, EE261/263/364A/364B); the CS229 course page links 40 transcript files under /materials/aimlcs229/transcripts/ (HTML + PDF), and a transcript HTML fetched 200 (62,928 bytes). Full text = transcript HTML/PDF. CC BY-NC-SA per the §29 survey.

name: Harvard CS50
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the CS50x 2025 index lists weeks 0-10 with their lecture topics (Scratch, C, Arrays, Algorithms, Memory, Data Structures, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS/JS, Flask, Cybersecurity/AI) and each week's notes page is full-text HTML (notes/1 = 105,312 bytes fetched 200). Scope is this one course only, per the §29 survey. Full text = notes HTML.

name: OpenLearn (Open University)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): every route from the sandbox — search (?query=), a course content page, and the site root — returned Cloudflare HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' (bot wall). The §29 survey verified full course text + printable PDFs in a browser environment, but no route answers from here, so neither bar can be proven. Routes tried: site search, course page, root.

name: TU Delft OpenCourseWare
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the WordPress search feed for 'water' returned 10 real items (course-lectures, course-readings, courses); a lecture item page carried 26,408 chars of text. The WP REST API is login-restricted (401 rest_login_required), so the search feed is the machine route. Full text = lecture/reading page HTML (course pages also link notes PDFs).

name: KOCW (Korea Open Course Ware)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the site search DOES answer (search.do?query=astronomy returned 12 real course pages at /home/cview.do?cid=...), and the §29 survey verified notes PDFs + WEBVTT/SRT caption files at predictable URLs in a browser session — but from static fetches the course page assembles its lecture list and subtitle data in JavaScript (no caption/.vtt/.srt file URL appears in the page HTML), so the full-text bar cannot be proven. Routes tried: site search, course page HTML, endpoint scan of the course page.

name: Oxford Podcasts (University of Oxford)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): no query route answers — /search?query=, /search?search= and /search/node/<q> all return the 404 page. The /series catalogue browses (a series page fetched 200) and SOME episode pages carry caption files (a Simonyi lecture episode linked a media.podcasts.ox.ac.uk .srt), but transcripts are per-episode only and there is no search route, so bar 1 fails. Routes tried: three search URL forms, series catalogue, episode page, per-series RSS feeds exist but are not a query route.

api: Moodle course search (course/search.php) + mod/resource pages resolving to pluginfile.php PDFs
name: METU OpenCourseWare (Middle East Technical University)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): Moodle course search answers as guest ('mathematics' found course id 83, Elements of Probability and Statistics); the course page links mod/resource items, a resource page resolves to its pluginfile.php PDF, and that PDF fetched 200 (%PDF). Guest access works for the open courses. Full text = resource PDFs.

name: Collège de France
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): /search?query=astronomie returns the research landing page (node/64) with no server-rendered results — the search is not machine-readable from here. Per the §29 survey only the inaugural lectures carry full text (regular courses publish résumés only), on chair pages and via OpenEdition Books (bot-challenged in §26) and HAL (already wired as a general searcher). Routes tried: site search (EN+FR), result-link extraction, API/Algolia scan of the search page.

name: PostNauka
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the site search page is a JS app (no result links in HTML). The public API at postnauka.org/api/v4/search answers, but for 'astronomy' it returned only author 'theme' cards (people), not lecture posts; the post-detail endpoint /api/v4/post/<id> returned 403 'not authorised', and /api/v4/video/<id> 404. Full text of the professors' lecture transcripts (verified in the §29 survey) is therefore not reachable through a proven machine route. Routes tried: site search HTML, API v4 search, API post/video detail, sitemap.

name: Saylor Academy
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the Moodle course search DOES answer with real courses ('biology' returned BIO101: Introduction to Molecular and Cellular Biology at /course/bio101), but the guest course page exposes NO unit content — its only mod/page items are the Course Syllabus (12,727 chars, a syllabus, not lecture text), a Translation FAQ and an AI Learning Zone page; no unit pages, no mod/url or mod/resource content links and no resources.saylor.org links appear. Unit full text is therefore not reachable through a proven static route, so bar 2 fails. This contradicts the §29 survey's 'unit text readable without login' note, which could not be reproduced from this sandbox. Routes tried: Moodle course search, course page, every mod/page item on the course page, external-link scan of the course page.

name: Wikiversity (English)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26) — LOW-CREDIBILITY COMMUNITY SOURCE: the MediaWiki API search answers with real learning-resource pages ('Astronomy', 'Introduction to astronomy', ...) and each page's full text is its wiki HTML, fetched like Wikisource in §27. Content is community-written and unrefereed — the weakest credibility in this registry (flagged per the §29 survey); it passes the same screening judges as every other source and is never trusted on its own.

name: OpenStax (Rice University)
notes: LIVE-WIRED §32 (probe 2026-11-26): TEXTBOOKS, not lectures (flagged per the §29 survey). The web view is a JS app and archive.cnx.org closes connections from the sandbox, but the archive JSON on openstax.org answers: the book tree for Astronomy 2e (464 nodes) and a page JSON for §1.1 'The Nature of Astronomy' with its full content. The site config embedded in a book page lists all 127 books (id + defaultVersion) + the archive version — that config is the catalogue; section titles are matched against the query. Full text = page JSON content.

name: NTU OpenCourseWare (National Taiwan University)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): Cloudflare HTTP 403 'Just a moment...' on every route from the sandbox — course page, /courses and the site root, over both https and http. The §30 survey verified full lecture-notes PDFs at the predictable /uploads/course_item_file/file/<id>/..._CS<unit>L01.pdf pattern (Calculus Ch.5 notes fetched) in another environment, but no route answers from here. Routes tried: course page, course index, root, http+https.

name: NOUN e-Courseware (National Open University of Nigeria)

A file pattern is not a search route, so bar 1 fails. Routes tried: e-courseware page, WP REST search, WP media search.

name: Greek Open Courses (opencourses.gr + Open eClass)
notes: REGISTRY-ONLY §32 (probe 2026-11-26): the national portal is a stateful JSF/PrimeFaces application (jsessionid-bound forms — no machine search route). Routes tried: portal root/search surface, UoA eClass root, eClass faculty catalogue.
